historical_context: P1 and original R2 EKF exploratory results already known; no predetermined improvement direction

tests.rule: Exact contract/config/tolerance SHA and pinned source git blob, original P1 and P0 receipts
39 C0 physical original file bytes, two bank original bytes, archived 14-trace ZIP and per-trace SHA
tests.threshold: exact SHA256 and size or BLOCKED

tests.rule: Independent FD f and 4D analytic F including F_psi,b=-dt
Independent F P F' + G Q G' vs pinned predict plus PSD
Independent scalar and joint S/K/Joseph canaries vs pinned EKF4
tests.threshold: state and P max difference <=1e-10; PSD

tests.rule: Pinned sensor-v2 seed0 B0 and positive L2, same controls within route
Exact shared initial state/P from frozen R2 recipe
d+B_OLD, analytic 4D range H versus independent FD
Pinned SourceFFD complex FFD plus stable J_s
tests.threshold: prior P1 signed independent preflight thresholds; H bias column=0

tests.rule: Range chi2_1 gate and Joint chi2_2 independent NIS with exact R0
tests.threshold: gate equality and NIS <=1e-9 on canary

tests.rule: t0 through t_final, each arm propagates own posterior; no reusing DR baseline
tests.threshold: every status and pre/post xP present, no silent missing

tests.rule: Separate truth-only scorer, RMSE, bias, NEES, coverage and resource rates
tests.threshold: all denominators explicit, all failures visible, no IID timepoint CI

tests.rule: No truth, true-bias or labels provided to runtime filter
tests.threshold: fail on truth input to inference or learned mu/R

tests.rule: Strict one Corridor 7 pairs, no New RT or M2
tests.threshold: full exact population; no claim of 7 independent RF scenes

tests.rule: Post-run independent formula audits of all matched outputs
tests.threshold: numeric metric agreement <=1e-9, no deleted cases, preserve FAIL inputs

stop: Any U00-U14 fail blocks run; U15 is mandatory post-run, not license to adjust thresholds
scientific_interpretation: one historical C0 scene only, no external holdout
